items.title: Migrate the five active reviewer role prompts behind independent rollback flags
items.context: Move concept, quality, test-coverage, behavior, and docs to modular role assets; retired channel must remain excluded and legacy-full-context must remain readable.

happy.desc: Exactly concept, quality, test-coverage, behavior, and docs resolve to versioned modular Role Contracts and trusted prompt assembly when each role flag is enabled; each role keeps its existing reviewer lane identity, commands, stop conditions, and finding/pass authority.

Each of the five active reviewer roles has an independent rollback flag whose enabled and disabled states select modular and legacy assembled prompts only for that role, with no cross-role flag coupling.

Registry and default dispatch report the five migrated roles as active while lattice-review-channel remains retired, defaultDispatch=false, absent from active counts, wave budgets, assurance floor, receipt, and quorum collection.

With a role flag disabled, the role can still execute through the legacy assembled prompt and existing envelope-less historical reviewer artifacts remain readable only as legacy-full-context in their recorded round.

edge.desc: All mixed flag combinations are supported: any subset of the five roles may use modular prompts while the rest use legacy prompts, and every lane retains its own contract and evidence identity.
Missing, malformed, duplicated, or unknown per-role flag configuration fails to the documented legacy-safe state or an explicit error; it never silently enables another role or retired channel.
Compatibility roles remain explicitly callable only under their compatibility contract and are excluded from active role counts and default reviewer waves without being incorrectly retired.

A role-by-role baseline diff proves required sections, forbidden actions, allowed commands, stop conditions, lane identity, and current authority are preserved; any semantic deletion blocks approval even when rendered text is shorter.

adversarial.desc: Direct, aliased, mixed-case, or flag-assisted attempts to dispatch lattice-review-channel for a new review are explicitly rejected and cannot fall through to an active role.
Changing one role flag, agentType, registry index, or cached prompt cannot cause another role contract or prompt to be served; role, contract, and envelope digests must agree.
A valid-looking pass or finding from retired or compatibility roles cannot satisfy any active lane, current-round receipt, assurance floor, delivery check, or quorum requirement.

Concurrent role migrations, rollback requests, and baseline approvals cannot lose updates or produce a hybrid registry or baseline; shared writes use the main write lock while lane evidence remains signed and lane scoped.

items.title: Assemble trusted full or eligible incremental reviewer Prompt Envelopes
items.context: Reuse Story 2 full-envelope provenance and Story 4 fail-closed eligibility; contract, policy, scope, freshness, or authority drift must deterministically select full.

items.title: Prove per-role quality and input reduction with preregistered replay
items.context: Use Story 3 replay/usage harness; require seeded critical/high detection or mark INCONCLUSIVE, report per-role assembled tokens, and require at least 50% incremental-context reduction with a 40% initial assembled-prompt target.

items.title: Preserve reviewer authority and verify rollback, compatibility, and process contracts
items.context: Run role-by-role baseline diff, approval, feature-flag rollback, old-pass compatibility, signature/permission gates, adversarial drift escalation, and documentation synchronization.
